name: promotional-revenue
description: coupon filtered revenue and grouped campaign performance

queries.name: promo-gross
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE coupon = 'promo'

queries.name: promo-by-category
queries.sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE coupon = 'promo' GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: nonpromo-count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NULL
